parsed.text: Using the supplied origins and times: copied prior records shown as current are not new estimates, and candidate (command) records are conditional alternatives, not executed events. Current panel p0: n0 shows a concentrated blue peak at (0,1) and red peak at (0,3); n1 and n2 are uniform 4×4 distributions for both roles; n3 shows a concentrated blue peak at (1,2) and red peak at (0,1). Candidate command records for p0 preserve those peaks at n0 and uniformity at n1/n2; n3’s conditional estimates across k0–k2 differ only in distribution sharpness but keep blue peak at (1,2) and red at (0,1). Current panel p1: n0 matches p0’s concentrated peaks; n1 and n2 are uniform; n3 in current p1 is uniform. Candidate records in p1 present distinct alternatives for n3: k0 concentrates blue on four cells [(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)] and red on four cells [(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)]; k1 leaves n3 uniform; k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1).
